votes.motion: Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-69 — A Resolution appointing an Administrative Services Director. Council Member Aston seconded the motion. Council Member Austin-Yes, Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Crockett-Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes

Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2025-15 — Regarding a Proposed Amendment to the Centrum Development Agreement to Add a Fifth Story and 66 Dwelling Units to an Approved Apartment Building located at approximately 14676 South Porter Rockwell Boulevard, including a Reduced Parking Ratio of 1.6 Stalls per Dwelling Unit. Council Member Aston seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Crockett-Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes, Council Member Austin-No

Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2025-16 — Regarding a Proposed Text Amendment to Section 11.110.130 of the Bluffdale City Code to Add a Fifth Story and 66 Dwelling Units to an Approved Apartment Building located at approximately 14676 South Porter Rockwell Boulevard, including a Reduced Parking Ratio of 1.6 Stalls per Dwelling Unit. Council Member Aston seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Crockett- Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes, Council Member Austin-No, Council Member Aston-Yes
